title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
headline: Google DeepMind and Singapore Gov build on-device scam detection AI
summary: Google DeepMind and the Government Technology Agency of Singapore have fine-tuned a lightweight Gemma model to detect complex social engineering scams on-device. The system uses a two-stage pipeline to analyse conversation patterns locally without accessing user data or compromising encryption. Development followed strict governance controls, including a sovereign sandbox and training exclusively on anonymised datasets.
why_it_matters: The project demonstrates a privacy-preserving governance model for deploying AI on-device to handle sensitive threat detection without cloud data exposure.

quotes.text: Together, we've fine-tuned a privacy-preserving, on-device scam detection model.
Strict governance was maintained throughout development: Sovereign Sandbox: Fine-tuning took place within GovTech Singapore's managed and maintained GCP environment, keeping training data isolated.

dates_mentioned.what: Publication of Google DeepMind blog post regarding the collaboration.

classification.significance_reason: Demonstrates a concrete operational deployment of fine-tuned frontier models for fraud and scam detection using strict on-device privacy and sovereign governance controls.
